translations.web: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
translations.bsb: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
translations.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
translations.asv: I come quickly: hold fast that which thou hast, that no one take thy crown.
